name: wisdomtree
description: WisdomTree — storage-first knowledge platform (modular monolith: Next.js App Router + Drizzle + PostgreSQL)

scripts.demo: docker compose up -d db && npm run db:migrate && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=1 npm run db:seed && npm run build && ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN=1 next start
scripts.demo:dev: docker compose up -d db && npm run db:migrate && ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_SEED=1 npm run db:seed && next dev --turbopack
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:boundaries && npm run test:authz && npm run test:sign && npm run test:time && npm run test:contrast
